verdict.rationale: Canny publishes a human-readable API Reference and an llms.txt documentation index, but neither is a machine-readable API spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, so this applicable axis is unmet.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
